channel: BibleProject

summary.en: An animated walk through the literary design of Genesis — creation, human rebellion, and the call of Abraham's family through whom God promises to bless the nations.

topic.en: The book that opens the patriarchal story

channel: BibleProject

summary.en: The literary design of Exodus 1-18: God's confrontation with Pharaoh, the deliverance of Israel, and the journey toward Sinai.

channel: BibleProject

summary.en: How the New Testament is designed as a single story that continues the Hebrew Bible and centers on Jesus of Nazareth.

channel: BibleProject

summary.en: Acts 1-12: the risen Jesus sends the Spirit, and the good news spreads from Jerusalem outward through Peter and the early church.

channel: BibleProject

summary.en: Acts 13-28: the multiethnic church sends out missionaries — above all Paul — carrying the message across the empire toward Rome.

title.en: What Early Church Buildings were in Capernaum?

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts explores the archaeological ruins of Capernaum, detailing the history of early Christian worship spaces, the octagonal church, and the house of Peter.

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts traces the physical route of Jesus' trial and suffering in Jerusalem, from the Upper Room and Gethsemane to the House of Caiaphas and Pilate's Judgment Seat.

topic.en: The trial and condemnation of Jesus

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts takes a tour of the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem, exploring the cave traditionally identified as the birthplace of Jesus.

title.en: Why was Jesus run out of Nazareth?

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts visits the hometown of Jesus, Nazareth, and explains the historical context of his rejection in the synagogue after reading from Isaiah.

title.en: First Miracle of Jesus at Cana

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts visits Cana of Galilee, examining the wedding feast account in John 2, the stone water jars, and the historical candidates for the location of the wedding.

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts examines the ancient 1st-century fishing vessel — the "Jesus Boat" — discovered in the mud of the Sea of Galilee near Ginosar and now housed at the Yigal Allon Museum, a hull carbon-dated to the time of Jesus.

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts visits Golgotha and the Garden Tomb area in Jerusalem, investigating the Roman methods of crucifixion and the archaeological evidence for the execution of Christ.

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts explores the historical and archaeological evidence for the resurrection of Jesus Christ, investigating the tomb structures and early eyewitness accounts in Jerusalem and Galilee.

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts explores Bethlehem and the traditions surrounding Jesus' birth — the Church of the Nativity and the town singled out by the prophet Micah (Micah 5:2; Luke 2:1-7).

title.en: Shepherds in the Fields near Bethlehem

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: The fields outside Bethlehem where, according to Luke 2, shepherds keeping watch by night received the angelic announcement of the Messiah's birth.

title.en: Church of the Annunciation in Nazareth

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts visits Nazareth and the Church of the Annunciation, marking the tradition of Gabriel's announcement to Mary that she would bear Jesus (Luke 1:26-38).

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: The wilderness ministry of John the Baptist at the Jordan River and the baptism of Jesus, which opens his public ministry (Matthew 3; Mark 1:1-11).

topic.en: John the Baptist and Jesus' baptism

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: An overview of the Sea of Galilee — the freshwater lake that was the setting for much of Jesus' Galilean ministry: calling the fishermen, calming the storm, and walking on the water.

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: At Caesarea Philippi, in the shadow of the pagan shrines at the foot of Mount Hermon, Peter confesses Jesus as "the Messiah, the Son of the living God" (Matthew 16:13-20).

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts reconstructs Herod's Temple Mount in Jerusalem — its courts, the sanctuary, and its central role in Jewish worship and in Jesus' final week.

title.en: Jesus in the Garden of Gethsemane

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: The Garden of Gethsemane on the Mount of Olives, where Jesus prayed in anguish and was betrayed and arrested on the night before his crucifixion (Matthew 26:36-56).

title.en: Golgotha Location – The Place of the Skull

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Dave Stotts weighs the candidate locations for Golgotha, "the place of the skull" — the Church of the Holy Sepulchre and the Garden Tomb — where Jesus was crucified (John 19:17-18).

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: The night trial of Jesus before the high priest Caiaphas and the Sanhedrin, which preceded his handover to the Roman governor Pilate (Matthew 26:57-68).

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: In Bethany, near Jerusalem, Jesus raises Lazarus from the dead — a sign recorded in John 11 that sharpens the authorities' resolve against him just before the triumphal entry.

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: Jesus passes through Jericho on his final ascent to Jerusalem, healing blind Bartimaeus at the roadside (Mark 10:46-52; Luke 18:35-43).

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: The chief tax collector Zacchaeus climbs a sycamore tree in Jericho to glimpse Jesus, who calls him down and dines at his house — "the Son of Man came to seek and save the lost" (Luke 19:1-10).

channel: Drive Thru History with Dave Stotts

summary.en: At Jacob's Well near Sychar in Samaria, Jesus speaks with a Samaritan woman about "living water," crossing a sharp ethnic and religious divide (John 4:1-42).

topic.en: The Samaritan woman at the well
